mismatches.reason: The statement is an unconditional implication that ETH sent requires debt accounting, but the predicate guards it with an unrelated not-stuck_eth_extractable antecedent.
The statement only claims no extraction of stuck ETH, but the predicate additionally asserts ETH was sent and debt accounting was not performed.

V asserts not-stuck_eth_extractable and not-debt_accounting_performed with eth_sent, which under I's implication would require debt_accounting_performed, directly contradicting V, but I's extra stuck_eth guard makes the intended violation not a clean direct contradiction of the stated invariant.
